debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-m-p-i-l-e-d a r-o-m-a-n-t-i-c p-e-r-s-o-n-a p-r-o-f-i-l-e u-s-i-n-g s-t-o-l-e-n i-d-e-n-t-i-t-y t-r-a-i-t-s and l-e-f-t a f-o-r-g-e-d s-t-o-r-y-b-o-a-r-d w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e s-t-a-t-e-m-e-n-t a-u-d-i-t
2) the a-c-t-o-r d-e-p-l-o-y-e-d t-e-m-p-l-a-t-e m-s-g-s t-o b-u-i-l-d t-r-u-s-t o-v-e-r w-e-e-k-s and l-e-f-t a n-a-t-i-v-e m-s-g h-i-s-t-o-r-y l-o-g w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e c-o-o-l-d-o-w-n p-a-u-s-e v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
3) the a-c-t-o-r s-c-r-i-p-t-e-d u-r-g-e-n-t e-m-e-r-g-e-n-c-y s-c-e-n-a-r-i-o s to i-n-d-u-c-e i-m-m-e-d-i-a-t-e p-a-y-m-e-n-t-s and l-e-f-t a p-a-y-m-e-n-t r-e-q-u-e-s-t a-r-c-h-i-v-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e f-r-a-u-d u-r-g-e-n-c-y m-e-t-r-i-c t-h-r-e-s-h-o-l-d
4) the a-c-t-o-r r-e-c-r-u-i-t-e-d m-u-l-e a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s v-i-a c-o-d-i-f-i-e-d r-e-c-r-u-i-t-m-e-n-t m-s-g-s and l-e-f-t a b-e-n-c-h m-a-r-k u-p-s-t-r-e-a-m t-r-a-i-l w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e s-o-u-r-c-f-u-n-d-s o-r-i-g-i-n t-r-a-c-i-n-g
5) the a-c-t-o-r i-m-p-l-e-m-e-n-t-e-d c-r-o-s-s v-i-c-t-i-m i-s-o-l-a-t-i-o-n t-a-c-t-i-c-s to p-r-e-v-e-n-t s-h-a-r-i-n-g d-e-t-a-i-l-s and l-e-f-t a b-l-o-c-k-e-d c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n a-r-t-i-f-a-c-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e w-i-t-n-e-s c-o-r-r-e-l-a-t-i-o-n r-e-v-i-e-w
6) the a-c-t-o-r r-o-t-a-t-e-d d-o-m-a-i-n a-s-s-e-t-s f-o-r c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n c-h-a-n-n-e-l-s and l-e-f-t a d-o-m-a-i-n r-e-g-i-s-t-r-a-t-i-o-n l-o-g w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e a-s-s-e-t t-e-s-t i-m-e l-i-m-i-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n
7) the a-c-t-o-r e-x-t-r-a-c-t-e-d a-d-d-i-t-i-o-n-a-l f-u-n-d-s t-h-r-o-u-g-h f-a-l-s-e i-d e-n-c-r-y-p-t-i-o-n r-e-q-u-e-s-t-s and l-e-f-t a f-u-n-d-s-t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r r-e-c-e-i-p-t w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n a-m-o-u-n-t l-i-m-i-t
8) the a-c-t-o-r d-i-s-c-a-r-d-e-d u-s-e-d i-d e-n-c-r-y-p-t-i-o-n a-s-s-e-t-s a-f-t-e-r u-s-e and l-e-f-t a d-i-s-c-a-r-d e-d a-s-s-e-t l-o-g w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e l-a-g n-o-t-i-c-e r-e-t-r-o a-c-t-i-v-e p-r-o-t-o-c-o-l
9) the a-c-t-o-r m-a-i-n-t-a-i-n-e-d p-e-r-s-o-n-a c-o-n-s-i-s-t-e-n-c-y a-c-r-o-s-s m-u-l-t-i-p-l-e c-h-a-t s e-s-s-i-o-n-s and l-e-f-t a c-h-a-r-a-c-t-e r f-u-l l-m-e-t-a d-a-t-a-b-a-s-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e b-e-h-a-v-i-o-r-a-l c-o-n-s-i-s-t-e-n-c-y c-h-e-c-k
10) the a-c-t-o-r f-i-n-a-l-i-z-e-d e-v-i-d-e-n-c-e d-e-s-t-r-u-c-t-i-o-n p-r-o-c-e-d-u-r-e-s and l-e-f-t a c-l-e-a-n-u-p c-e-r-t i-f-i-c-a-t-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e f-o-r-e-n-s-i-c i-n-t-e-g-r-i-t-y s-c-a-n
